UDR.src: Debt maturity table (total debt column), Note 6

ELME.src: Notes payable table (term loan, 30-year notes, green bonds)

NXRT.src: Debt maturity table (operating properties and credit facility)

UMH.src: Mortgage and loans payable maturity tables; excludes revolving lines of credit

OLP.src: Mortgage principal schedule (amortization plus amounts due at maturity)

ARE.src: Secured and unsecured debt maturity table

BXP.src: Mortgage principal schedule plus the unsecured senior notes table (by maturity date)

HPP.src: Debt maturity table (unsecured and secured debt; excludes joint venture partner debt)

BFS.src: Debt maturity table (balloon payments plus amortization)

GNL.src: Mortgage notes future principal payments; excludes the revolving credit facility and senior notes

FVR.src: Revolving credit facility and term loan, both due October 3, 2027

CHCT.src: Credit facility table (revolver due 10/29, term loans due 3/28 and 3/30)

SHO.src: Debt maturity table (term loans shown at extended maturity, as the company presents them)

CUBE.src: Unsecured senior notes table plus mortgage principal schedule; excludes any revolver balance

GOOD.src: Mortgage principal schedule plus revolver, term loans and senior notes (by maturity date)
